meta.name: x-search
meta.description: MUST read before searching X/Twitter with the x_search tool. When xAI is connected: date-bound every time-sensitive query (from_date >= yesterday, widen to 7 days), scope trusted accounts with allowed_x_handles, phrase queries as latest/recent with since:/from:/filter: operators, split into 2-3 searches by account and by keyword, and reconcile against web_search. Triggers: X search, Twitter search, tweets, posts on X, what people are saying on X, x_search, social signal.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 锁定最新日期与可信账号，精准搜出X上的相关推文
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果常在X上搜索话题，并希望只看最新、来自可信账号的说法。
copy.tagline_en: Find the latest, trustworthy X posts using date and trusted-account filters.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you search X for topics and want up-to-date, credible takes from trusted accounts.

howto.what: 连上 xAI 后,Claude 会用 x_search 搜 X(推特):给时效查询加日期范围、限定可信账号、拆成 2~3 次检索,并与网页搜索对照。汇报时每条结论附 x.com 链接,说明是 X 上谁发的帖子,而不是当成已核实的事实。
howto.when: 当你提到「X 搜索」「推特帖子」等关键词,或想知道 X 上人们在说什么时触发;前提是已连接 xAI 账号,否则它会说明不可用并改用网页搜索。

say.text: 搜一下昨天 X 上关于英伟达的帖子,只看我信任的那几个账号
say.note: 限定日期并限定可信账号范围

say.text: 查查 X 上最近关于这个产品发布的热帖,不要回复
say.note: 按关键词搜一轮,去掉回复

say.text: 把网上新闻和 X 上的反应对照一下
say.note: 同一轮跑网页搜索并做对照

howto.what_en: With xAI connected, Claude uses x_search on X: it date-bounds time-sensitive queries, scopes trusted accounts, splits into 2–3 searches and cross-checks web_search. Claims get x.com links, labeled as posts, not verified facts.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you mention “X search”, “Twitter search”, “x_search” and similar terms, or ask what people are saying on X. Requires an xAI credential; otherwise it falls back to web_search.

say_en.text: Search X for yesterday's Nvidia posts, only from accounts I trust
say_en.note: Bounds the date and scopes allowed_x_handles.

say_en.text: Find recent X posts about this launch, replies excluded
Compare the web coverage with what X is saying
say_en.note: Runs web_search in the same turn and reconciles.
